title: 第1421章 九千叶剑草准备离开绝灭之地第1420章 绝灭之地的意志化身绝灭之地来历
slug: 全民成野神唯有我百倍供品
content_zh:
第1421章九千叶剑草，准备离开绝灭之地
“这是——九千叶剑草？！”
李越震动。
这一座星辰之中，竟然是一株大如山岳、拥有九千叶子的剑草！
他从未想过，九叶剑草一族，还能诞生出拥有九千片叶子的同族！
其上密密麻麻的剑叶，每一片都如锋利剑器，密密麻麻，剑气如风暴席卷！
“世间万物，皆有一线可能。”
“九叶剑草一族，微不足道，要证道禁忌生命都几乎不可能。”
“但高天之上，曾有一株九叶剑草走出了不同寻常的道。”
“他一步一个脚印，采高天之上众多剑道融为一炉，成就自身的终极剑道。”
“最终他证道了超脱。”
“成为高天之上有史以来第一株证道超脱的九叶剑草一族。”
“但他不满足于超脱一重境。”
“加入了某一方大势力，奉命来到绝灭之地。”
“可悲可叹。”
“在绝灭之地受到三位同阶超脱者围攻，最终陨落。”
“若是在高天之上，哪怕受到四五位同阶超脱者围攻，也绝不至于陨落。”
“这是他的尸身。”
“吾将之种在了‘九天息壤’一族的某位超脱级尸体上。”
“最终结出了一颗无上剑果。”

“此果在绝灭之地众多宝物中，也足以排在前二十名了。”
女子平静道。
她素手轻挥。
那九千叶剑草身上密密麻麻的叶子一片片散开，显现出一颗通明的无上剑果！
恍惚间——
李越仿佛从这一棵无上剑果上，看到了一株九叶剑草为了追寻剑道，万死不悔的终极剑道！
甚至——
他觉得自己修炼的‘终极十三道剑’，都有对方的影子！
他突然想到——
‘终极十三道剑’的信息介绍中有一句话，是那位创造‘终极十三道剑’的祖师所留。
——吾有幸见到了活着的终极剑道，以此创出十三剑，便斗胆命名为终极十三道剑。
活着的终极剑道！
他当初很疑惑这一句话，什么叫做活着的终极剑道？
如今见到这一颗无上剑果，也就明白什么叫做活着的终极剑道了。
这位九千叶剑草，对于剑道不如他者来说，就是活着的终极剑道！
当然——
苍云海一脉的那位祖师，所见者当不是这位九千叶剑草。
而是另一位远在其上、同样修终极剑道的恐怖存在！
但毫无疑问。
这一颗无上剑果，对于他修‘终极十三道剑’绝对有难以想象的好处！

“此物你可用一千四百枚万能绝灭之玉兑换。”
“此为绝灭之地规则。”
content_en:
Chapter 1421 Nine Thousand Leaf Sword Grass, preparing to leave the land of extinction
"This is - Nine Thousand Leaves Sword Grass?!"
Li Yue was shocked.
Among the stars was a sword grass as big as a mountain with nine thousand leaves!
He never thought that the Nine-leaf Sword Grass clan could give birth to a clan with nine thousand leaves!
The densely packed sword leaves on it, each one like a sharp sword, are densely packed, and the sword energy is sweeping like a storm!
"Everything in the world has a glimmer of possibility."
"The Nine-leaf Sword Grass clan is so insignificant that it is almost impossible to realize the forbidden life."
"But high in the sky, there was once a nine-leaf sword grass that took an unusual path."
"He took one step at a time and merged many kendos from the sky into one to achieve his ultimate kendo."
"In the end he achieved transcendence."
"Become the first nine-leaf sword grass in the history of heaven to achieve enlightenment and transcendence."
"But he is not satisfied with transcending the first level."
"Joined a certain powerful force and was ordered to come to the land of annihilation."
"It's pathetic."
"Besieged by three transcendent beings of the same level in the Land of Extinction, he eventually fell."
"If you are high in the sky, even if you are surrounded by four or five transcendents of the same level, you will never fall."
"This is his body."
"I planted it on the corpse of a transcendent person from the 'Nine Heavens Breathing Earth' clan."
"In the end, a supreme sword fruit was born."
"This fruit is enough to rank in the top twenty among the many treasures in the Land of Extinction."
The woman said calmly.
She waved lightly.
The densely packed leaves of the Nine Thousand-leaf Sword Grass spread out one by one, revealing a transparent Supreme Sword Fruit!
In a daze——
Li Yue seemed to see a nine-leaf sword grass from this supreme sword fruit. In order to pursue the sword, he would never regret the ultimate sword!
Even——
He felt that the 'Ultimate Thirteen Swords' he cultivated all had the shadow of the other party!
He suddenly thought——
There is a sentence in the information introduction of the 'Ultimate Thirteen Swords', which was left by the founder who created the 'Ultimate Thirteen Swords'.
——I was lucky enough to see the living Ultimate Swordsman, and created the Thirteen Swords with it, so I boldly named it the Ultimate Thirteen Swords.
The ultimate kendo alive!
He was very confused about this sentence at first. What is the ultimate swordsmanship in life?
Now that I see this supreme sword fruit, I understand what the ultimate sword of living is.
This Nine Thousand Leaves Sword Grass is the ultimate living swordsmanship for those who are inferior to others in swordsmanship!
Of course——
The ancestor of the Cang Yunhai lineage must not have seen this Nine Thousand Leaf Sword Grass.
But there is another terrifying existence far above him who also practices the ultimate sword!
But there is no doubt about it.
This supreme sword fruit will definitely have unimaginable benefits for him in cultivating the 'Ultimate Thirteen Swords'!
"You can exchange this item for 1,400 Jade of Universal Destruction."
"These are the rules of the Land of Extinction."
